answer: Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, forfeited on duplicate submission, no identity may audit its own recruit. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the zenith of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. A cipher of per-task receipts records who did what, and the echo of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it.
